beschreibung.worum: Our monthly community evening – this time around {thema}. A short welcome, member news, then drinks and conversations that actually go somewhere.
beschreibung.rahmen: Evening format in the {ort} for around {kapazitaet} guests, drinks & snacks.

• 3–5 meaningful new contacts
• Knowing who can help with what

beschreibung.betreuung: On site: Host Team (welcome & bar), Membership Team
